article.title: Hindi to English: Work context sentence
article.description: Hindi: 'मुझे यह प्रोजेक्ट कल तक पूरा करना है।' English: 'I have to finish this project by tomorrow.' Teaching point: 'करना है' (have to do) is obligation, translated with 'have to' not 'must' here since it's a deadline-driven task obligation, not a personal rule.
article.content: Hindi: 'मुझे यह प्रोजेक्ट कल तक पूरा करना है।' English: 'I have to finish this project by tomorrow.' Teaching point: 'करना है' (have to do) is obligation, translated with 'have to' not 'must' here since it's a deadline-driven task obligation, not a personal rule.

generated.caption:
Ever found yourself needing to talk about a work deadline? 🤔 Here's a super useful phrase!

When you have an obligation for a task, especially one driven by a deadline, 'have to' is your perfect choice. It's great for expressing what you're required to complete.

For example: 'I have to finish this project by tomorrow.'

Save this tip for your next project! ✨ Follow @EnglishVault for more daily English lessons!
generated.script: Mujhe ye karna hai ko translate karte hue aksar log confuse hote hain, right? Dekho, jab bhi aapko bolna ho "mujhe yeh karna hai" aur woh ek deadline-driven obligation ho, tab hum use karte hain "have to". Not "must". Jaise ki, "मुझे यह प्रोजेक्ट कल तक पूरा करना है।" Iska sahi translation hoga: "I have to finish this project by tomorrow." Yahaan "have to" us obligation ko clearly dikha raha hai. Toh ab se, jab bhi aapko koi project deadline ke baare mein bolna ho, ya koi aisi obligation jo complete karni hai, toh use karna "have to". Simple! slides.body: When translating 'मुझे यह प्रोजेक्ट कल तक पूरा करना है,' the correct English is 'I have to finish this project by tomorrow.' The Hindi phrase 'करना है' indicates an obligation or a task that needs to be done. Here, 'have to' is used to express an external necessity, like a deadline or a rule, making it perfect for work-related obligations. In contrast, 'must' typically conveys a strong internal feeling of necessity or a personal rule, so it wouldn't be the best fit for this specific deadline-driven scenario.
slides.hindiSummary: किसी बाहरी आवश्यकता या समय सीमा दर्शाने के लिए 'have to' का उपयोग करें, जैसे 'मुझे यह प्रोजेक्ट कल तक पूरा करना है' में।
